summary: V2-02 REPAIR accepted. The candidate replaces the InMemory repositories for entries, persistentTasks and chronoTimer with AsyncStorage-backed persistent repositories (PersistentRepositories.ts), wires them into AppContext production wiring, adds a global AsyncStorage jest mock (jest.setup.js) and a 12-test non-tautological persistence suite proving write -> instance recreation -> read-back for all three repositories (create/read/sort/update/delete, per-household chrono isolation, null state, cross-repository persistence). The two tautological chrono resume tests in V2-02-acceptance.test.ts (which read the same in-memory map twice) were replaced with instance-recreation tests. Dependency @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@2.2.0 exactly matches the Expo SDK 57 bundled version. Trusted verification exit code is 0 (Android debug build successful, AsyncStorage native module compiled). npm run check is green: typecheck clean, 195 tests pass (183 pre-existing + 12 new), no regressions on V2-00/V2-01 invariants. Independent auditor check (app-level: write via ChoreScoreApp instance 1 with persistent repos, recreate full app instance 2, read back entries/persistentTasks/chrono; update/delete survive recreation) passed. No new feature scope introduced. No mustFix finding remains.

findings.problem: None. Tests are non-tautological: they write via one repository instance and read back via a freshly created instance sharing the AsyncStorage mock store, which would fail if data lived only in instance memory.
